detaileddescription.para: The CMPSS_LITE driver provides API to configure the CMPSS_LITE module. Below are the high level features supported by the CMPSS_LITE driver.

listitem.para: The DAC reference voltage can be set to VDDA.
Two digital filters, max filter clock prescale = 2^24.
Generate trip signals for MCPWM and for external signalling.
Latch or Invert output and also option to use hysteresis on output.

simplesect.para: It is strongly recommend to use SysConfig where it is available instead of using direct SW API calls. This will help simplify the SW application and also catch common mistakes early in the development cycle.

listitem.para: Configure value source of DAC in the CMPSS_LITE module.
Option to use hysteresis on the input.
Option for negative input of comparator to be driven by an external signal or by the reference DAC.

sect1.title: Example Usage
sect1.para: Include the below file to access the APIs #include <cmpss_lite.h>
